title: E0098: Session ID in URL
plain_english: Embedding session IDs in URLs via `session.use_trans_sid` exposes them in Referer headers, browser history, and server logs.
why_matters: Session IDs in URLs can: - Be leaked via Referer headers when users click external links - Be stored in browser history - Be logged by web servers and proxies - Be used for session hijacking
what_it_checks: Links containing `PHPSESSID` or similar session ID parameters
